content.title: A. O. Smith’s (NYSE:AOS) Q3 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
content.summary: Water heating and treatment solutions company A.O. Smith (NYSE:AOS) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 4.4% year on year to $942.5 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.83 billion at the midpoint came in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.94 per share was 3.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: A.O. Smith: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
